description: The organizations behind one product, each with its relation (produced_by_org, supplied_by, operated_by), its role, the relation status and the quote and source: makers, agencies, prime contractors, suppliers of named parts, operators. With include_components (default true) it also lists the organizations behind the products that are part of this one, so "who makes the engines used on Vulcan Centaur" is answered with via_product naming the engine. Suppliers appear only where a source states them: no row means not stated, not that there is no supplier.

include_components.description: Also list organizations behind products that are part of this one (engines of a launcher)

name: orgs_for
title: Who is behind a product
